problem: The projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of two sheets $-\frac{(x+1)^{2}}{18}+\frac{{y}^{2}}{2}+(z-2)^{2}=-1$ and the plane $z=3$ onto the $xy$-plane is a hyperbola. What are the lengths of the semi-axes of the hyperbola?

feedback.problem: What is the projection of the intersection between the hyperboloid of one sheet $\frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{8}+{z}^{2}=1$ and the plane $z=1$ onto the $xy$-plane?
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the intersection of the hyperboloid and the plane $z=1$, we substitute $z=1$ into the equation of the hyperboloid:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{8}+{1}^{2} & =1 \\ \frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{8}+1 & =1 \\ \frac{(x-2)^{2}}{2}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{8} & =0 \\ {y}^{2} & =4(x-2)^{2} \\ y & =\pm 2(x-2)\end{aligned}
$$

This gives us two intersecting lines: $y=2(x-2)$ and $y=-2(x-2).$
